senses.gloss: (cmp. דמם, דבב) to speak in a low voice, to suspect. Part. pass. דָּיִים suspected.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 52a:9">Yeb. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵידַם הוה דָ׳ מחימתיה</he> he was suspected of illicit relations with his mother-in-law; <cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:9">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>דַיְימָא חמתיה מיניה …</he> (v. Rashi to Yeb. l. c.) his mother-in-law was suspected &c.; <cite ref="Yevamot 69b">Yeb. 69ᵇ</cite> sq.
